source.identifier_note: The SHA-256 identifies the exact retained PDF inspected in this rapid source/argument check. Original supplied report bytes are retained locally. The original PDF retrieval timestamp is taken from matching retained metadata.
source.review_scope: Fresh original-PDF reading of the guidance and staged objective. Logit interpolation implies \(p_\lambda(w)\propto p_{\rm GRPO}(w)^\lambda p_{\rm SFT}(w)^{1-\lambda}\), normalized by softmax; endpoints recover the respective policies. Reported \(R^2=0.643\) and \(r=0.816\) satisfy \(R^2\le r^2=0.665856\). These are local algebra/interpretation checks, without author-code execution.
